title: Encrypted Chat App
description: A secure, end-to-end encrypted chat app using React, Node.js, and WebSocket
content:
# Overview

WhisperVault is a privacy-first secure messaging app and contact vault designed for small teams or power users who need authenticated, auditable communication with strong account protections.
It combines a modern React + Vite frontend with a TypeScript Express + Prisma backend and focuses on clear UX for contacts, identity, and secure message exchange.
Elevator pitch

A secure messenger and contact manager that makes it easy to find, verify, and message people while protecting accounts with email confirmation and optional 2‑factor authentication. Contacts can represent other app users or external identities (emails/phones) and are stored with normalized metadata and optional public keys.

## Key features

Authentication and account safety
Email confirmation workflow and JWT-based sessions.
Optional TOTP 2FA and SMS flows (speakeasy + SMS helpers).
Contacts and discovery
Structured Contact model with emails and phones, optional link to an app User record.
Search-for-new-contacts endpoint to find other users (excludes already-linked contacts).
Frontend search UI allowing paging and one-click add-to-contacts.
Messaging primitives
Message and Thread models, prepared for encrypted payloads (cipher modules in repo).
Message storage via Prisma with sender/receiver relations and thread metadata.
Data modeling & validation
Prisma schema with migrations and indexes for performance.
Zod schemas for request validation and a service-layer that encapsulates DB logic.
Developer ergonomics
TypeScript throughout, React Query for remote state, Tailwind for UI.
Clear service/route separation on the server and test stubs in place.

## Architecture

Frontend: React + Vite, Tailwind, React Query. Routes via react-router; pages for dashboard, messenger, contacts, sign-in/up, 2FA flows.
Backend: Express + Prisma (Postgres), modular route files, Zod validators, a services layer for DB operations, and utilities for crypto/email.
Persistence: Postgres (Prisma), migrations tracked in repo and client generated automatically.
Deployments: frontend targeted to Vercel, backend to Render/host; CORS allowlist and environment-aware base paths handled.
Security & privacy posture

Designed to minimize attack surface: typed server-side validation, constrained DB relations, and explicit owner checks on contacts and messages.
2FA options and email confirmation reduce account takeover risk.
Crypto code presence signals intent for message confidentiality; audit and end‑to‑end encryption hardening recommended before shipping.

## UX highlights

Contact-first layout: sidebar and dedicated contacts page with search for both existing contacts and new users.
Add-by-user flow: find users by name/email/phone and add them as structured contacts (links to User where available).
Mobile-friendly, responsive UI with modal add form and paged search results.

## Extensibility & next steps

Improve client UX: debounce search input, show “already added” state, and add optimistic UI when adding contacts.
Harden security: complete E2EE key exchange flow using the Contact.publicKey field, audit crypto flows, and add rate limiting on auth endpoints.
Analytics & monitoring: instrument backend metrics, add Sentry or similar for production monitoring.
Policies & tests: expand unit/integration tests and add end-to-end tests for auth + contact flows.

title: Hidden Empire Codex API
description: RESTful API built with Node.js and Express to serve protected grimoire data.
content:
# 📜 Hidden Codex

This portfolio is powered by a dynamic CMS and a custom Markdown engine.

## 💡 Architecture

- JSON + Markdown combo system
- Dynamic route handling via React Router
- TailwindCSS for expressive design

## ✍️ Editor Support

Markdown content is managed in `.md` files and supports:

- Headings, lists, images
- Code blocks
- Future support for frontmatter metadata

## ⚔️ Goal

Make content modular and scalable, with no need to hardcode UI data.

title: MythOS: Terminal Portfolio
description: A terminal-style portfolio with keyboard navigation and ASCII magic. React + Vite + Tailwind.
content:
# 🧬 Mythos: The Lore Engine

This is the soul of the system — a codified archive of your projects and ideas.

## 📖 Purpose

Create an immersive story-like presentation of projects with:

- Chapters as components
- Scrolls as `.md` files
- Animations and icons as relics

## 🔮 Vision

Let the portfolio **speak in legend**, not just code.  
A future where users explore, not just scroll.

title: Portfolio Generator
description: Drag-and-drop builder for personal sites, built with Vite and Postgres
content:
# 🧱 Portfolio Genesis

A full-stack system crafted to secure high-impact roles in tech.

## ⚙️ Stack

- Frontend: React + Vite + TailwindCSS
- Backend: Node.js + Express
- DB: PostgreSQL
- Hosting: Vercel (Frontend), Render/Fly.io (Backend)

## 🔁 Dev Experience

- Live reload via Vite
- Markdown routing
- JSON-powered projects
- Reusable component library

## 🏆 Outcome

This is more than a portfolio. It's an evolving platform.

> _Stone rots. Steel rusts. Only living myth endures._
